nodes.label: CommunityCard & Collapsible Chat Preview
nodes.rationale: Collapsible cards persisting expanded state in localStorage, previewing up to 3-4 community chats with unread badges and 'See all' navigation.

nodes.label: Migration 0012_communities.sql
nodes.rationale: Rewrites create_community RPC for atomicity of community + membership + General chat + owner chat membership, adds 7 community management RPCs, and defines succession triggers.

nodes.label: Edge Function: livekit-token
nodes.rationale: Validates call status, age (<5m), and chat_members membership using service role key before issuing a 15-minute LiveKit AccessToken JWT.

nodes.label: Migration 0013_calls_enhancements.sql & start_call RPC
nodes.rationale: Adds decline_reason and ended_reason columns, atomic start_call RPC restricting MVP calls to active 1:1 direct/self chats, and 20s pg_cron cleanup_stale_calls job (slightly > 15s frontend ring timeout for network tolerance).

nodes.label: useLiveKitRoom Hook & Active Call Modals
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates LiveKit Room connection, adaptiveStream/dynacast 720p video, audioLevelChanged waveform updates, and 3-second peer disconnect grace period before hangup.

nodes.label: VAPID Web Push, send-push Edge Function & Migration 0014
nodes.norm_label: vapid web push, send-push edge function & migration 0014
nodes.rationale: Uses pg_net triggers (notify_new_message, notify_new_call in 0014_push_triggers.sql) instead of Database Webhooks because fan-out requires joining chat_members. Sends Web Push via send-push Edge Function to devices.push_subscription and cleans up expired 404/410 subscriptions.

nodes.label: Netlify Function: /api/auth/logout-all
nodes.rationale: Calls supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.signOut(userId, 'others') to revoke refresh tokens on all other devices while keeping the current session alive.

nodes.label: SecurityScreen & SecuritySummaryCard
nodes.rationale: Read-only summary card aggregating 4 checks (TOTP 2FA enabled, unused backup codes count via exact head query, magic-link verified email, and active devices in last 30 days).

nodes.label: /health Route & /api/health Netlify Function
nodes.rationale: Provides both a human-readable /health SPA route probing Supabase and LiveKit with 2s timeouts and a serverless /api/health endpoint returning HTTP 200 vs 503 status codes for uptime monitors.

nodes.label: Roadmap #13: PWA, Offline & Push Notifications Specification
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #13: pwa, offline & push notifications specification

nodes.label: README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md & docs/FASE-2.md
nodes.rationale: Documents the 16-prompt roadmap index, manual pg_dump backup procedures, step-by-step production deployment across Supabase/LiveKit/Turnstile/Sentry/Resend/Netlify, and a consolidated Fase 2 deferred-features tracker.

nodes.label: Community Bulk Mute (mute_community RPC)
nodes.rationale: Community mute updates chat_members.muted_until in bulk across all chats belonging to the community for the current user.

nodes.label: Community Ownership Succession
nodes.rationale: If owner leaves or deletes their account, promote oldest admin first, then oldest member (promoting them to admin); if no members remain, hard-delete the community. Uses BEFORE DELETE on profiles so succession runs before FK nulls out owner_id.

nodes.label: Community Two-Pane Desktop / Fullscreen Mobile Layout
nodes.norm_label: community two-pane desktop / fullscreen mobile layout
nodes.rationale: Uses parent layout route (_authenticated.communities.$communityId.tsx) to render CommunityChatSidebar + Outlet on desktop (>=1024px) to avoid remounting sidebar on chat navigation, while rendering fullscreen on mobile.

nodes.label: CallProvider & callStore State Machine
nodes.rationale: Manages call lifecycle (idle, incoming-ringing, outgoing-ringing, answered, ending) via Zustand and Supabase Realtime on calls table, requesting getUserMedia permissions before connecting to LiveKit to avoid wasting tokens, and auto-rejecting concurrent incoming calls as busy.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Offline Cache & Message Outbox
nodes.rationale: Stores last 50 messages per chat and 200 chats in IndexedDB isolated by compound key [user_id, chat_id] and cleared on logout via clearAllUserData to prevent cross-account leaks. Enqueues text messages when offline and flushes up to 3 retries when online without Background Sync API.

nodes.label: VitePWA & Workbox Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses prompt registration mode, StaleWhileRevalidate (7d) for public avatars, and NetworkOnly for REST, Edge Functions, and private chat media (since signed URLs expire in 5 minutes and caching media risks privacy leaks). Disabled in dev to avoid cache issues.

nodes.label: Privacy, Visibility, Storage & Account Deletion Wiring
nodes.norm_label: privacy, visibility, storage & account deletion wiring
nodes.rationale: Connects existing settings screens to user_settings, user_blocks, file_uploads, get_my_storage_usage, and schedule_account_deletion/cancel_account_deletion RPCs, enforcing fair-trade confirmation before disabling read receipts.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI & netlify.toml Security Headers
nodes.norm_label: github actions ci & netlify.toml security headers
nodes.rationale: Runs pnpm typecheck, lint, and build on main, while netlify.toml configures SPA redirects, Service-Worker-Allowed headers, X-Frame-Options DENY, HSTS, and strict Content-Security-Policy covering Supabase, LiveKit, Turnstile, and Sentry.

nodes.label: Sentry Error Tracking & Privacy-First Replay
nodes.rationale: Uploads source maps at build time without serving them publicly, samples 10% of traces to stay within Sentry's 5k/month free tier, masks all text/inputs/media in session replays, and strips URLs containing access_token or refresh_token in beforeSend.

nodes.label: Supabase Typed Client (src/lib/supabase.ts)
nodes.rationale: Wraps @supabase/supabase-js with auto-generated Database types from supabase gen types typescript so frontend queries remain strictly typed against the live Postgres schema.

nodes.label: handle_new_user() Auth Onboarding Trigger
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER trigger on auth.users AFTER INSERT that automatically provisions public.profiles (with placeholder username user_<8hex>) and public.user_settings rows.

nodes.label: SilverChat 21-Table Postgres Schema (0001_initial_schema.sql)
nodes.rationale: Defines 13 enums and 21 tables (profiles, user_settings, devices, chats, chat_members, messages, message_receipts, message_reactions, message_deletions, chat_requests, user_blocks, reports, stories, story_views, channels, channel_followers, communities, community_members, calls, file_uploads, app_config).

nodes.label: profiles_visible Column-Level Privacy View
nodes.rationale: Because Postgres RLS is row-level and cannot mask columns, profiles is restricted to self-only SELECT while profiles_visible (with security_invoker = false, security_barrier = true) masks avatar_url via can_view_avatar(), masks last_seen_at via presence_visible, and filters out blocked users.

nodes.label: Row Level Security Policies & Helper Functions (0002_rls_policies.sql)
nodes.norm_label: row level security policies & helper functions (0002_rls_policies.sql)
nodes.rationale: Enables RLS on all 21 tables and storage.objects using 13 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER helpers (is_chat_member, is_blocked_either_way, is_contact, can_view_avatar, can_view_story, etc.), enforcing RPC-only writes on sensitive tables, 15-minute message edits, 1-hour delete-for-everyone, and bidirectional fair-trade read receipts.

nodes.label: Database Business-Logic Triggers (0003_business_logic.sql)
nodes.rationale: Implements compute_message_preview, handle_new_message (auto-receipts + denormalized chat/channel previews), handle_message_update, handle_community_member_insert/delete (counter + auto-join community_chats), handle_channel_follower_insert/delete, and handle_chat_member_delete (auto-promote oldest member or cascade-delete empty group).

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime Publication & pg_cron Housekeeping Jobs
nodes.norm_label: supabase realtime publication & pg_cron housekeeping jobs
nodes.rationale: Publishes messages, chat_members, calls, message_receipts, and stories to supabase_realtime (excluding chats to avoid high-frequency denormalized update noise) and schedules 4 pg_cron jobs for stale ringing calls, expired stories, pending uploads, and orphaned uploads.

nodes.label: 13 Atomic SECURITY DEFINER RPCs
nodes.rationale: Provides controlled server-side mutations for tables where direct client INSERT is blocked by RLS: create_direct_chat_request (enforcing 7-day rejection cooldown), create_self_chat, create_group_chat, add_chat_member, accept_chat_request, reject_chat_request, create_channel, follow_channel, create_community, join_community, mark_chat_as_read, delete_message_for_everyone, and get_my_storage_usage.

nodes.label: Client Token Manager, AuthProvider & _authenticated Route Guard
nodes.norm_label: client token manager, authprovider & _authenticated route guard
nodes.rationale: Configures src/lib/supabase.ts with persistSession: false and custom 401 retry fetch via src/lib/auth.ts, hydrates session state in AuthProvider, guards protected routes via _authenticated.tsx, and runs a 60s presence heartbeat updating profiles.last_seen_at and devices.

nodes.label: TOTP 2FA Enrollment & SHA-256 Backup Codes (0004_auth_backup_codes.sql)
nodes.rationale: Combines Supabase Auth MFA TOTP enrollment with 10 client-generated, SHA-256-hashed single-use backup codes stored in public.two_factor_backup_codes and verified server-side via the BFF.

nodes.label: LiveKit Token Generation Edge Function
nodes.rationale: LiveKit requires server-signed JWT access tokens that cannot be generated safely in the browser; a ~30-line Supabase Edge Function handles on-demand token generation.

nodes.label: SilverChat Infrastructure Stack
nodes.rationale: Locked zero-cost MVP stack combining Supabase (DB/Auth/Storage/Realtime), LiveKit Cloud (voice/video calls), Resend (transactional magic-link email), and Netlify (frontend hosting) with a billing-only upgrade path to ~10,000 concurrent users.

nodes.label: Frontend SPA Tech Stack (Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript Strict)
nodes.norm_label: frontend spa tech stack (vite 6 + react 19 + typescript strict)
nodes.rationale: Uses Vite 6+, React 19, strict TypeScript, pnpm, TanStack Router v1 (SPA mode), TanStack Query v5, Zustand, react-hook-form + Zod, lucide-react, Tailwind CSS v4, and Biome for a fast, type-safe single-page messenger.

nodes.label: Glassmorphism (.glass-surface) & Motion Tokens
nodes.rationale: Defines standardized motion durations/easings with prefers-reduced-motion reset and a .glass-surface utility for chrome overlays while keeping message bubbles and cards solid for legibility and WCAG AA contrast.

nodes.label: Billing-Only Scaling Strategy (0 to 10k Users)
nodes.rationale: Ensures transitioning from ~3 prototype users to ~10,000 concurrent users requires only upgrading provider billing plans without rewriting backend or frontend code, while maintaining pg_dump Postgres portability.

nodes.label: TanStack Router v1 SPA Mode
nodes.rationale: Chosen over TanStack Start because web messengers are SPAs by design, SSR conflicts with PWA offline caching, chat content does not need SEO, and SPA mode avoids meta-framework complexity.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4 @theme inline Bridge
nodes.rationale: Uses @theme inline in src/styles/globals.css so Tailwind utility classes reference dynamic CSS variables at runtime rather than resolving static values at build time.

nodes.label: Three-Layer CSS Token Cascade (Accent, Semantic, Component)
nodes.norm_label: three-layer css token cascade (accent, semantic, component)
nodes.rationale: Separates OKLCH design tokens into Accent (--neon, --neon-glow, --neon-magenta, --neon-lime), Semantic (--primary, --background, --silver, etc.), and Component (--gradient-neon, --shadow-glow) layers so switching among 6 accent themes (.theme-*) or light/dark modes cascades automatically.

nodes.label: Decoupled File Metadata (file_uploads) & Storage Seam (src/lib/storage.ts)
nodes.rationale: Separates file metadata in file_uploads from private Supabase Storage buckets (avatars, chat-media, story-media, channel-media) and wraps client SDK access in src/lib/storage.ts with client-side WebP compression to enable quotas and future migration to R2/B2/S3.

nodes.label: Unified Chats & Unified Messages Architecture
nodes.rationale: Consolidates direct, group, self, and community_chat into a single chats table (with deterministic direct_pair_key and denormalized last_message_* fields) and merges chat and channel messages into a single messages table with a mutually exclusive chat_id XOR channel_id constraint.

nodes.label: Netlify Functions BFF & HttpOnly Refresh Cookie Architecture
nodes.norm_label: netlify functions bff & httponly refresh cookie architecture
nodes.rationale: Stores long-lived Supabase refresh tokens in an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie managed by 6 Netlify Functions (auth-signin, auth-callback, auth-refresh, auth-logout, auth-turnstile-verify, auth-backup-code-verify) while holding the 1-hour access token only in JS memory to prevent XSS token exfiltration.

nodes.label: UI Foundation Primitives & Native Modal Top-Layer Contract
nodes.norm_label: ui foundation primitives & native modal top-layer contract
nodes.rationale: Preserves native <dialog> Modal for top-layer modality, nested Tab ownership, and busy Escape prevention while offering Radix Dialog/Sheet with portalContainer for deliberate integration and @layer components wrapping legacy feature sheets.

nodes.norm_label: contact profiles, group admin rpcs & shared media (prompt 09 / migration 0011)
nodes.rationale: Implements add/remove/promote/demote/update_group_info and clear_chat_for_me RPCs with parent-chat locking, creator protection, MFA enforcement, and privacy-respecting profiles_visible queries.

nodes.label: Active Chats List, Filters, Requests & Local Drafts (Prompt 07 / Migration 0007)
nodes.norm_label: active chats list, filters, requests & local drafts (prompt 07 / migration 0007)
nodes.rationale: Separates manually_unread from message receipts, batches child queries in chunks of 50, coalesces Realtime invalidations at 100ms, and scopes localStorage drafts by ownerId.

nodes.label: Communities Hierarchy, Succession & Shared Conversation (Prompt 11 / Migration 0014)
nodes.norm_label: communities hierarchy, succession & shared conversation (prompt 11 / migration 0014)
nodes.rationale: Creates atomic General chats on community creation, enforces owner succession to oldest admin/member via triggers, synchronizes child-chat moderation roles, and reuses Conversation and GroupSettingsScreen.

nodes.label: Hardened Message Actions & Exclusive Voice Notes (Prompt 08b / Migration 0010)
nodes.norm_label: hardened message actions & exclusive voice notes (prompt 08b / migration 0010)
nodes.rationale: Uses serialized RPCs for 3-pin limits, idempotent reaction upserts, and 5-chat atomic forwarding without re-uploading media, plus 40-sample SVG waveforms and audioStore exclusive playback.

nodes.label: Conversation History, Optimistic Outbox & Private Media (Prompt 08a / Migration 0008)
nodes.norm_label: conversation history, optimistic outbox & private media (prompt 08a / migration 0008)
nodes.rationale: Implements get_chat_messages cursor pagination, XHR uploads with BFF JWT and AbortController, WebP image compression, 4-minute signed URL refresh, and client-UUID deduplication for optimistic sends.

nodes.label: New Direct Chat & New Group Creation Flows (Prompt 07 Gap Fix)
nodes.norm_label: new direct chat & new group creation flows (prompt 07 gap fix)
nodes.rationale: Replaces FutureChatPage with /chats/new and /chats/new-group using debounced profiles_visible search, 8-hex handle matching, 7-day rejection cooldown handling, and user_blocks fallback resilience.

nodes.label: 24h Stories & Broadcast Channels Architecture (Prompt 10 / Migration 0012)
nodes.rationale: Enforces a serialized 10-active-story cap with idempotent retry UUIDs, requestAnimationFrame story timers, DM-routed story replies, and broadcast channels sharing MessageList/Composer in channelMode.

nodes.label: Prompt 09 Contact Profile & Chat Settings Verification Report
nodes.norm_label: prompt 09 contact profile & chat settings verification report
nodes.rationale: Verifies 52/66 UI items for ContactProfileModal, ChatOptionsMenu, GroupSettingsScreen, ReportModal, SharedMediaView, LeaveGroupModal, and ClearChatModal while deferring 14 community-dependent checks to Prompt 11.

nodes.label: Prompt 08b Message Actions Verification Report
nodes.rationale: Confirms static, schema, automated, and manual verification of replies, reactions, edits, deletions, forwarding, pins, local search, and SVG/native voice notes under migration 0010.

nodes.norm_label: prompt 10 novedades local verification & staging blocker status
nodes.rationale: Documents local validation of migration 0012 (stories and channels) and records the HTTP 401 staging Management API token blocker preventing remote schema push.

nodes.norm_label: supabase cli setup & health check workflow
nodes.rationale: Standardizes one-time npx supabase login/link setup and idempotent non-interactive health check scripts for developers and AI agents.

nodes.label: SilverChat SPA & Backend Stack Overview
nodes.rationale: Defines the privacy-first messaging SPA built on Vite, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase, LiveKit, and Netlify across 16 incremental roadmap prompts.

nodes.label: Remote Migration History Repair Blocker (0001-0007)
nodes.rationale: Because migrations 0001-0007 were applied manually in the SQL Editor, supabase migration repair --status applied must be run before any future supabase db push.

nodes.label: src/features/settings/components/AppearanceScreen.tsx
nodes.rationale: Replaces the stub AppearanceScreen from Prompt #6, wiring useThemeContext, useLanguage, and useTranslation so users can interactively switch theme mode, OKLCH accent color, and UI language.

nodes.label: src/lib/i18n.ts (i18next Configuration)
nodes.rationale: Configures i18next with react-i18next and i18next-browser-languagedetector across 9 namespaces and 2 languages (en, es). Sets useSuspense: false to avoid breaking React Router and TanStack suspense boundaries, normalizes regional browser locales (e.g. es-MX to es), and must be imported first in main.tsx before any component calls t().

nodes.label: src/app/providers/I18nProvider.tsx
nodes.rationale: Replaces the stub I18nProvider from Prompt #2 by wrapping the application in react-i18next's I18nextProvider.

nodes.label: src/types/i18n.d.ts (TypeScript i18next Definitions)
nodes.rationale: Provides compile-time type safety for t() calls across all 9 translation namespaces using English locale JSON schemas as the canonical type source.

nodes.label: src/app/main.tsx (Entry Point i18n Initialization)
nodes.rationale: Imports ./lib/i18n as the very first statement before React and App so i18next is initialized before any module or component invokes t().

nodes.label: src/lib/theme.ts (Theme & Accent Helpers)
nodes.rationale: Separates theme mode (data-theme='dark' attribute only for explicit dark since light is :root default in Prompt #3 CSS) and accent color (theme-{accent} class on <html>) as two independent dimensions, wrapping localStorage access in try/catch for Safari private mode.

nodes.label: src/app/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx
nodes.rationale: Replaces the stub ThemeProvider from Prompt #2 with a real context provider exposing theme, accent, setTheme, and setAccent via useThemeContext.

nodes.label: src/hooks/useFormatters.ts (Intl Locale Formatters)
nodes.rationale: Uses native browser Intl APIs (DateTimeFormat, RelativeTimeFormat with numeric: 'auto' for natural strings like 'yesterday', NumberFormat) instead of external date libraries to keep bundle size small while remaining reactive to i18n.language.

nodes.label: src/hooks/useLanguage.ts
nodes.rationale: Synchronizes active language across i18next, localStorage, and Supabase user_settings (with 500ms debounce and post-login override for cross-device consistency).

nodes.label: src/hooks/useTheme.ts
nodes.rationale: Manages runtime theme and accent state with dual persistence (immediate localStorage + 500ms debounced user_settings DB update to prevent rapid accent previews from hammering the database) and attaches a prefers-color-scheme media query listener only when theme === 'system'.

nodes.label: 18 Locale JSON Files (9 Namespaces x en/es)
nodes.norm_label: 18 locale json files (9 namespaces x en/es)
nodes.rationale: Organizes all UI translations into 9 domain namespaces (common, auth, chats, messages, calls, communities, novedades, settings, errors) across English and Spanish using native i18next _one/_other pluralization.

nodes.label: Prompt #14: Internationalization & Theme System Specification
nodes.rationale: Wires up the design system from Prompt #3 with user preferences from Prompt #6 to prepare SilverChat for multi-language (en, es) and multi-theme (light/dark/system + 6 accents) support without translating existing components inline.

nodes.label: Dual Persistence Pattern (localStorage + Supabase user_settings)
nodes.rationale: Persists theme, accent, and language to localStorage for instant pre-auth/offline boot and FOUC prevention, while syncing with Supabase user_settings (which overrides localStorage on login) as the cross-device source of truth.

nodes.label: index.html Inline FOUC Prevention Script
nodes.rationale: Must be inline and synchronous before any stylesheet or module script in index.html so that data-theme, theme-{accent}, and lang attributes are applied on <html> before the first CSS paint, preventing a flash of unstyled/wrong-themed content.

nodes.label: Migration 0005: Profile Settings & Block Enforcement Triggers
nodes.norm_label: migration 0005: profile settings & block enforcement triggers

nodes.label: Device Fingerprinting & Session Management (devices.ts)
nodes.rationale: Generates a persistent UUID in localStorage['silverchat_device_id'] with a nullable unique constraint (user_id, device_fingerprint) to tolerate strict browser privacy modes while supporting 'Sign out all other devices'.

nodes.label: Social Links Normalization (social-links.ts)
nodes.rationale: Stores 5 fixed social platforms and up to 20 custom label/URL pairs in profiles.social_links JSONB so new fields require no schema migration.

nodes.label: ChatContextMenu, MultiSelectToolbar & SwipeActions
nodes.rationale: Combines mobile touch swipe actions, long-press/right-click context menus, desktop hover icons, and a bulk multi-select toolbar for pinning, favoriting, muting, archiving, marking read/unread, blocking, and deleting chats.

nodes.label: 30-Day Account Deletion Grace Period & Scheduled Cleanup
nodes.norm_label: 30-day account deletion grace period & scheduled cleanup
nodes.rationale: Provides a 30-day reversible grace period via profiles.scheduled_deletion_at, a root-level PendingDeletionBanner, and a daily Netlify Scheduled Function (cleanup-deleted-accounts.ts) that calls supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.deleteUser to cascade delete profile and anonymize messages.

nodes.label: check_blocked_on_message_insert Trigger
nodes.rationale: Runs as SECURITY DEFINER on messages BEFORE INSERT to check chat_members and is_blocked_either_way across users, preventing direct messages in either direction between blocked users while keeping the chat visible under the Blocked filter.

nodes.label: Privacy Visibility Exclusions & Read Receipts Fair-Trade Rule
nodes.norm_label: privacy visibility exclusions & read receipts fair-trade rule
nodes.rationale: Controls photo and story visibility via Everyone, Contacts, Contacts Except (multi-select exclusions array), or Nobody, and enforces a bidirectional fair-trade rule when disabling read receipts.

nodes.label: validate_username_change Trigger (30-Day Username Cooldown)
nodes.rationale: Enforces the 30-day username change cooldown and blocks reverting to placeholder user_xxxxxxxx usernames at the Postgres trigger level so client-side validation cannot be bypassed.

nodes.label: Composer, Lazy Emoji Picker (frimousse) & @Mention Autocomplete
nodes.rationale: Provides an auto-resizing textarea with 500ms debounced draft saving, lazy-loaded frimousse emoji picker (~15 KB), 4-option AttachmentMenu, and group-only @mention autocomplete.

nodes.label: MessageContent Dispatcher & 9 Content Subtypes
nodes.rationale: Renders text (with linkify-react noopener/noreferrer/nofollow and @mentions), image (aspect-ratio reserved + MediaLightbox), video (poster + click-to-play), audio, file, sticker, location, contact, and system messages.

nodes.label: Migration 0008: Message Mentions GIN Index & Profiles Realtime
nodes.norm_label: migration 0008: message mentions gin index & profiles realtime

nodes.label: MessageBubble & Consecutive Message Grouping (groupMessages.ts)
nodes.rationale: Groups consecutive messages from the same sender within a 5-minute gap on the same calendar day using pure rounded-2xl bubbles without tails, signaling continuation via 1px vertical spacing.

nodes.label: Prompt #8a: Chat Layout, Message Rendering & Composer Specification
nodes.norm_label: prompt #8a: chat layout, message rendering & composer specification

nodes.label: LocalStorage Chat Drafts System
nodes.rationale: Stores per-chat drafts synchronously in localStorage['silverchat_draft_{chat_id}'] with a 30-day cleanup so the chat list can render 'Draft: ...' preview overrides immediately without network round-trips.

nodes.label: ChatHeader & Polling Presence (useChatPresence)
nodes.rationale: Polls profiles_visible every 30s in direct chats and 60s in group chats because RLS on the underlying profiles table restricts Realtime row broadcasts to the profile owner.

nodes.label: Client-Side Media Upload & Progress Flow (upload.ts / MediaPreviewModal)
nodes.norm_label: client-side media upload & progress flow (upload.ts / mediapreviewmodal)
nodes.rationale: Uses XMLHttpRequest instead of fetch to report upload progress and support AbortController cancellation, compressing images to WebP (max 2048px, 0.82 quality) and extracting video thumbnails client-side before inserting the message.

nodes.label: Optimistic Message Send & Status Computation (useSendMessage / messageStatus.ts)
nodes.norm_label: optimistic message send & status computation (usesendmessage / messagestatus.ts)
nodes.rationale: Uses temp- prefixed IDs for optimistic messages and computes pending, sent, delivered, read, or failed status from message_receipts while skipping duplicate realtime INSERT echoes.

nodes.label: VoiceRecorder, VoicePlayer & Exclusive Audio Playback Store (audioStore.ts)
nodes.norm_label: voicerecorder, voiceplayer & exclusive audio playback store (audiostore.ts)
nodes.rationale: Records up to 5-minute voice notes via MediaRecorder (audio/webm;codecs=opus with audio/mp4 fallback), computes 40 normalized waveform peaks client-side via Web Audio API for lightweight static SVG rendering, and enforces single-active-player exclusivity via Zustand.

nodes.label: cleanup-deleted-accounts Scheduled Function
nodes.rationale: Daily scheduled cleanup removes tracked Storage objects before calling auth.admin.deleteUser after a 30-day grace period, retaining failed accounts for retry and locking rows on cancellation to avoid cross-service race conditions.

nodes.label: Private Avatar Upload and SHA-256 Palette Mechanism
nodes.norm_label: private avatar upload and sha-256 palette mechanism
nodes.rationale: Avatars use private WebP storage keys (<100KB, 512x512) with pending-to-completed upload bookkeeping and deterministic SHA-256 first-byte modulo 12 palettes requiring no database column.

nodes.label: profiles_blocked Management View
nodes.rationale: Own-block-list MFA-gated view exposing only ID, display name, username, and computed avatar initials without joining profiles_visible (which would drop blocked rows) or leaking avatars, presence, bio, or links.

nodes.label: Migration 0005 CRLF vs LF Function Body Guard Resolution
nodes.norm_label: migration 0005 crlf vs lf function body guard resolution
nodes.rationale: Windows CRLF working-tree checkout stored \r\n inside create_direct_chat_request, tripping 0005's exact-text anti-drift guard; resolved by normalizing the function body to LF, applying 0005-0007 from committed LF git blobs, and enforcing eol=lf in .gitattributes.

nodes.label: Supabase Migrations 0001-0004 Schema, RLS & Business Logic
nodes.norm_label: supabase migrations 0001-0004 schema, rls & business logic
nodes.rationale: Establishes 22 tables, 13 enums, profiles_visible privacy view, restrictive MFA assurance policies, invoker triggers for separate edit/delete windows, column grants protecting server-managed fields, and serialized direct chat request RPCs.

nodes.label: ContactProfileModal (useContactProfile)
nodes.rationale: Renders an in-chat modal for a contact's profile using profiles_visible and LEAST/GREATEST direct_pair_key lookup, disabling Call/Video actions until a pending chat request is accepted.

nodes.label: GroupMembersList, AddMembersModal & GroupSettingsScreen
nodes.rationale: Implements route-based group info (/chats/$chatId/info), admin-gated role management, avatar picker reuse, and bulk member addition (up to 50 users from contacts plus 300ms debounced global search).

nodes.label: Migration 0010: Group Admin RPCs, Clear Chat & Shared Media Indexes
nodes.norm_label: migration 0010: group admin rpcs, clear chat & shared media indexes
nodes.rationale: Provides SECURITY DEFINER RPCs for bulk adding members (silently skipping blocked users to avoid leaking block state), removing/promoting/demoting members (protecting group creator from demotion/removal), updating group info, and soft-clearing chat history via message_deletions.

nodes.label: SharedMediaView (SharedMediaTab & SharedFilesTab)
nodes.rationale: Lazily queries shared images/videos and files at 30 items per page under /chats/$chatId/media using dedicated partial indexes on messages.

nodes.label: ChannelView, ChannelHeader & ChannelInfoScreen
nodes.rationale: 1-to-many broadcast channel view reusing MessageList in channelMode where only the owner sees ChannelComposer, followers can react with 8 emojis or copy, and channel messages use messages.channel_id.

nodes.label: Client-Side WebP Avatar Upload & Crop Flow (avatar-upload.ts / AvatarPickerModal)
nodes.norm_label: client-side webp avatar upload & crop flow (avatar-upload.ts / avatarpickermodal)
nodes.rationale: Crops avatars via react-easy-crop and compresses client-side to 512x512 WebP (0.85 quality) via browser-image-compression before tracking in file_uploads and uploading to the avatars bucket.

nodes.label: Prompt #9: Contact Profile & Chat Settings Specification
nodes.norm_label: prompt #9: contact profile & chat settings specification

nodes.label: MessageList Cursor Pagination & Scroll Preservation
nodes.rationale: Uses 50-message cursor pagination (created_at < oldest) without virtualization in MVP, restoring scroll offset via requestAnimationFrame on prepend and auto-scrolling on initial load to the unread marker or bottom.

nodes.label: ChatListItem & WhatsApp-Style Checkmarks
nodes.rationale: Renders chat rows with deterministic gradient avatars, presence dots, type-prefixed previews, state overrides (deleted, failed, pending, draft), and worst-case delivery/read checkmarks.

nodes.label: ChannelsSection, DiscoverChannelsSection & CreateChannelModal
nodes.rationale: Displays followed channels with unread/mute states, top 20 unfollowed channels ordered by follower_count DESC, and channel creation with auto-generated slug validation.

nodes.label: Migration 0011: Stories & Channels RPCs and Schema Additions
nodes.norm_label: migration 0011: stories & channels rpcs and schema additions
nodes.rationale: Adds messages.reply_to_story_id and channel_followers.muted_until, and defines RPCs for create_story (enforcing max 10 active stories), idempotent mark_story_viewed, hard delete_story, get_story_viewers, unfollow_channel, and update_channel_info.

nodes.label: StoryCreator & StoryTextEditor (storyColors.ts)
nodes.rationale: Creates camera/gallery media stories (WebP image compression, <=15s video enforcement) and 200-char text stories using the first 8 palettes from AVATAR_GRADIENTS.

nodes.label: StoryViewer, useStoryTimer & StoryReplyInput
nodes.rationale: Fullscreen modal story viewer using requestAnimationFrame timing (5s for image/text, up to 15s for video), an owner viewers bottom sheet, and story replies sent as DMs via create_direct_chat_request with reply_to_story_id.

nodes.label: StoriesRow, StoryCard & Story Ordering (storyOrdering.ts)
nodes.rationale: Orders 24-hour stories horizontally with the user's own story card first, followed by contacts with unwatched stories DESC, then watched contact stories DESC.

nodes.label: Deterministic SHA-256 Avatar Gradient (avatar.ts)
nodes.rationale: Computes a deterministic fallback gradient from the SHA-256 hash of user_id modulo 12 fixed palettes (AVATAR_GRADIENTS), avoiding a database column and staying consistent across devices and cache clears.

nodes.label: InChatSearch & PinnedMessagesBar (useInChatSearch / usePinnedMessages)
nodes.rationale: Implements local substring search over loaded messages with a 2-second CSS highlight fade and a collapsible top bar displaying up to 3 pinned messages.

nodes.label: Migration 0009: Voice Peaks, Forward Tracking & 3-Pin Limit Trigger
nodes.norm_label: migration 0009: voice peaks, forward tracking & 3-pin limit trigger
nodes.rationale: Adds media_peaks and forwarded_from_message_id columns, publishes message_reactions to Realtime, and enforces the 3-pinned-messages-per-chat limit via check_pin_limit BEFORE UPDATE trigger to prevent race conditions.

nodes.label: ChatFilters & Scoped Local Search Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Provides 7 URL-persisted filter chips (All, Favorites, Unread, Groups, Archived, Muted, Blocked) and applies 150ms debounced local search after filtering so search is always scoped to the active filter.

nodes.label: ReactionsPicker & ReactionsDisplay (useReactions)
nodes.rationale: Offers 8 fixed quick emojis plus full frimousse picker with 1 reaction per user per message (toggling same emoji deletes, choosing different emoji upserts) and live Realtime updates.

nodes.label: Chat Action Availability Matrix & ChatOptionsMenu (chatActions.ts)
nodes.rationale: Determines available chat-level actions by chat type (direct, group/community, self) and admin status, using muted_until = '9999-12-31T23:59:59Z' to represent 'Always muted'.

nodes.label: Prompt #8b: Message Actions & Voice Notes Specification
nodes.norm_label: prompt #8b: message actions & voice notes specification

nodes.label: Message Action Availability Matrix (actionMatrix.ts)
nodes.rationale: Pure function computing allowed message actions (reply, react, copy, forward, pin/unpin, edit within 15m, delete_for_me, delete_for_everyone within 1h) from message metadata and currentUserId.

nodes.label: MessageRequestsSection (Accept & 7-Day Cooldown Decline)
nodes.rationale: Displays pending message requests above the main chat list when filter is All or Unread; accepting moves the chat to the main list while declining silently removes it and blocks sender retries for 7 days.

nodes.label: Migration 0007: Chat Delete Adjustments & Read/Unread RPCs
nodes.norm_label: migration 0007: chat delete adjustments & read/unread rpcs

nodes.label: useChats, useMessageRequests & Realtime Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Fetches up to 200 active chats ordered by pinned_at DESC and last_message_at DESC, batches message_receipts for unread counts and checkmarks, separates pending_request chats into useMessageRequests, and subscribes to messages, chat_members, and message_receipts.

nodes.label: ReplyPreview, ForwardModal, EditMessageModal & DeleteMessageModal
nodes.rationale: Handles composer/bubble reply previews, forwarding to up to 5 chats by copying file_upload_id without re-uploading, 15-minute text/caption editing, and delete-for-me vs delete-for-everyone placeholder replacement.

nodes.label: Per-Type Chat Deletion RPCs (delete_self_chat / delete_direct_chat_for_me)
nodes.rationale: Uses delete_self_chat to hard-delete self-chats (avoiding orphaned memberless chats) while delete_direct_chat_for_me and relaxed chat_members DELETE policy remove only the user's membership row for direct/group chats.

nodes.label: Manual Unread Flag (chat_members.manually_unread)
nodes.rationale: Adds an explicit manually_unread boolean column on chat_members rather than setting last_read_at to NULL because mark_chat_as_read already sets read_at on message_receipts.

nodes.label: Auto-Mark-Read Triggers (useMarkAsRead)
nodes.rationale: Calls mark_chat_as_read RPC after 1000ms on initial load at bottom or 500ms when a new message arrives while at bottom and document is visible, never marking read while scrolled up.

nodes.label: Supabase Health Outage Detection and Recovery Probe
nodes.community_name: Query Storm & Story Burst Fix Docs
nodes.norm_label: supabase health outage detection and recovery probe
nodes.rationale: Detects PostgREST 5-class SQLSTATE/PGRST codes and HTTP 5xx errors in QueryCache.onError, pauses focusManager, and probes every 15s to prevent retry amplification.

nodes.label: Novedades Query Storm Fix Report
nodes.community_name: Query Storm & Story Burst Fix Docs

nodes.label: Story Media Signed URL Burst & Slow get_story_viewers Fix Report
nodes.community_name: Query Storm & Story Burst Fix Docs
nodes.norm_label: story media signed url burst & slow get_story_viewers fix report

nodes.label: Novedades Query Storm Mitigation (B1-B7)
nodes.community_name: Query Storm & Story Burst Fix Docs
nodes.rationale: Opening /novedades fired ~50 requests in ~2s saturating the Supabase free-tier pool; fixed by caching avatar signed URLs by path with 300s TTL, session-wide Set dedupe on mark_story_viewed, 30s staleTime gating focus refetches, bounded retries with Zustand outage banner, and 10s auth-refresh race timeout.

nodes.label: get_story_viewers RPC Optimization (Migration 0013)
nodes.community_name: Query Storm & Story Burst Fix Docs
nodes.rationale: Replaces the join against security_barrier view profiles_visible (which prevented predicate pushdown and forced full table scans taking ~23s) with direct indexed joins on profiles and user_settings plus explicit block and avatar privacy checks (~200ms).

nodes.label: Lazy IntersectionObserver & Jittered Signed URL Refresh (Fixes A, B, D, E)
nodes.community_name: Query Storm & Story Burst Fix Docs
nodes.norm_label: lazy intersectionobserver & jittered signed url refresh (fixes a, b, d, e)
nodes.rationale: Prevents synchronized 4-minute signed URL refresh bursts and Storage 504 cascades by gating useMediaUrl/Avatar with IntersectionObserver (useInView 100px rootMargin), extending story/channel TTLs to 1 hour with 50-55m jittered refresh, retaining decoded HTMLImageElement instances in memory, and opening a 60s storage circuit breaker on 503/504.

nodes.label: Standalone Visual Review Server (pnpm review:ui)
nodes.rationale: Serves the migrated UI fixture on http://127.0.0.1:5177/ without requiring credentials or the Netlify auth backend.

nodes.label: UI Migration Closeout Policy
nodes.rationale: Records Module 6A as the final chat-list migration and preserves _ui_reference donor paths strictly as historical provenance after directory deletion.

nodes.label: Phased UI Migration Execution Log (Modules 1-6A)
nodes.rationale: Chronicles the verification of Shell (M1), Timeline & Interactive Messaging (M2A/2B), Communities & Channels (M3A/3B), Stories & Settings (M4A/4B), Chat Settings/Auth/Cleanup (M5A/5B/5C), and Final Chat-List Homologation (M6A).

nodes.label: UI Migration Foundation & Tailwind v4 Tokens (F01-F06)
nodes.norm_label: ui migration foundation & tailwind v4 tokens (f01-f06)
nodes.rationale: Establishes canonical globals.css tokens, mode-invariant primary neon gradients, selective Radix UI primitives, and MIME-first FileIconTile without importing prototype SSR/Start dependencies.

nodes.label: Component & Route Traceability Matrix (T001-T148)
nodes.rationale: Maps all 148 TSX files across Direct, Partial, Homologate, and Infrastructure categories while preserving existing TanStack Router URLs and Supabase data contracts.

nodes.label: Bidirectional Contract Ledger & Verification Gates
nodes.rationale: Guarantees that query keys, RPC payloads, optimistic UUIDs, audio exclusivity, focus traps, and privacy views remain reachable and verified after visual migration.

nodes.label: SilverChat Working Agreements (CON-006 to CON-012)
nodes.rationale: Enforces step-by-step Step A hook extraction before JSX edits (CON-006), single commit per turn (CON-007), screenshot-free functional browser assertions (CON-008), branch publishing without PRs (CON-010), reduced-motion-safe 150-200ms micro-animations (CON-011), and explicit green/red evidence reporting (CON-012).

nodes.label: Step A Workflow Extraction Queue
nodes.rationale: Requires moving direct Supabase client leaks and multi-step business workflows into dedicated hooks and passing tsconfig.app.json typecheck before any Step B JSX changes.

nodes.label: Magic-Link BFF & Cookie Session Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses six Netlify Functions to store the refresh token in an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie and keep the access JWT in memory only, with persistSession:false and autoRefreshToken:false.

nodes.label: AAL2 MFA Refresh & Backup Code Recovery Contract
nodes.norm_label: aal2 mfa refresh & backup code recovery contract
nodes.rationale: Upgrades the session to AAL2 inside POST /api/auth/refresh and writes the rotated AAL2 refresh cookie directly so page reloads preserve AAL2 without re-prompting TOTP.
